snippet.title: MR. RECORDS | Steam Next Fest Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The first public demo for MR. RECORDS is available now on Steam!

By day, run the shop, meet its colourful customers and help them find the perfect record. By night, dive into George’s imagination as every song transforms into a vibrant rhythm adventure.

Play the demo now and get ready for Steam Next Fest this October.

Coming to PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2.

PLAY NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4869950/MR_RECORDS_Demo/
